text: Welcome.
Find a position where you can let your weight settle.
Let your eyes close.
Take a slow breath in, and a long breath out, arriving here in this moment with yourself.
Somewhere in you there may be a weight you have been carrying, a guilt, a sense of something
you wish had gone differently.
You can let it be here gently.
Notice where it lives in the body, perhaps in the chest, perhaps across the shoulders
or in the center of the body.
Breathe toward that place.
With each breath in, imagine a soft, warm light gathering there.
Guilt often means you care.
It means your heart was in it.
You can honor that and set the weight down.
Remember yourself these words gently.
I did the best I could with what I knew then.
I am allowed to be human.
As you breathe out, let the warm light carry some of the heaviness with it.
Softening, releasing what you have held, breathing in warmth, breathing out the weight.
With each breath, it grows a little lighter.
If there is a person held in this guilt, perhaps yourself, you can include them in this warmth
too.
Cover yourself the same kindness you would offer a dear friend.
Notice the space that opens as you let some of this go.
A little more room, a little more ease.
You can carry this lightness with you.
This is something you can return to, breath by breath.
Take one more slow breath in.
And let it go.
When you are ready, let your eyes open and bring this ease with you into the rest of your
day.
